subject: SoftBurst allocation & discount structure for mid-Nov launch
messages:
From: Ben Fisher <ben.fisher@launchco.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@launchco.com
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick ask — temporary buffer for launch week

Hi Lauren,

We’re about to kick off a regional rollout next Tuesday and we’re seeing a much higher spike in pre-prod traffic than expected. Our forecast suggests we’ll exceed our committed quota by ~55% for a 72-hour window (Nov 17–19).

We don’t want to move to a higher committed tier long-term, but we need a short-term headroom so the product experience isn’t degraded. Is there a way Redwood can provision a time-limited burst allowance or a provisional overrun credit to smooth the week? If so, what would the cost split look like and what approvals do you need from our side?

Appreciate a quick turnaround — Ben
Ben Fisher
Head of Product, LaunchCo
ben.fisher@launchco.com
+1 (415) 555-0194

Attachments: launchco-usage-snapshot-nov.csv (CSV, 24 KB)

From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Fisher <ben.fisher@launchco.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, mina_haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick ask — temporary buffer for launch week

Hi Ben — thanks for the heads up and the usage snapshot.

We can support a short, conditional burst lane for Nov 17–19 with a blended approach we’ve piloted for similar launches:
- SoftBurst allowance: one-time window up to 60% over committed quota for 72 hours.
- Billing: 50% of overrun usage charged at your current committed unit rate; Redwood absorbs the other 50% as a one-time launch concession.
- Cap: we’d hard cap the allowance to avoid open-ended exposure (we’ll propose an absolute token ceiling + per-minute throttle).
- Acceptance items from LaunchCo: a signed amendment (PO or DocuSign) that accepts the temporary allowance and confirms invoice timing, and a contact for post-window reconciliation.

I’m attaching a short term-sheet (redwood-softburst-term-sheet-v1.pdf) with the mechanics and the suggested acceptance language. Karthik — can you confirm we can route this through our hosted pool without SLA impact if LaunchCo agrees? Mina — I’ll need a quick estimate on the expected incremental tokens and a suggested invoice note.

Ben — if that sounds reasonable, I can draft the amendment today and route it for signatures so we can turn this on Monday morning PST.

Next steps: please confirm approval + procurement contact, we’ll send amendment and go/no-go checklist.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood-softburst-term-sheet-v1.pdf (PDF, 48 KB)

From: procurement@launchco.com <procurement@launchco.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Ben Fisher <ben.fisher@launchco.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 07:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick ask — temporary buffer for launch week

Hi Lauren — we can accept a short concession if the amendment includes:
1) An explicit token ceiling (we prefer a buffer of +60% but only up to an absolute 4.2M-token cap for the window).
2) A guarantee that normal committed rates apply to the portion we pay (no surprise premium multipliers).
3) An invoice schedule: net 30 after reconciliation, with a one-line description of the temporary allowance.
4) A mutual rollback clause — if usage extends beyond Nov 19 without prior written agreement, we revert to standard overrun terms.

Please send the amendment and we’ll escalate for a PO.

Procurement Team
LaunchCo
procurement@launchco.com

- Mina attached the estimated incremental usage and reconciliation sample (see redwood-softburst-term-sheet-v1.pdf). Our billing team will invoice the net amount for the portion LaunchCo accepts (50% of overrun) after Nov 19, with a one-line description.

- We’ll enable the allowance at 00:00 PST Nov 17 and disable at 23:59 PST Nov 19.
- We’ll provide a reconciliation report (per-minute summary + token totals) within 48 hours of window close.
- If you want an earlier reconciliation checkpoint during the window, request it and we’ll turn on a live dashboard share.
